document_api_meta.title: Get SPS Metric Top Items
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Returns the top products for NRR, NBFR, or AHT, or the top logistics providers for OTDR.
Shop Performance Score (SPS) reflects a shop’s performance across key operational and service metrics on TikTok Shop. By integrating the read-only SPS APIs, ISVs can retrieve a shop’s score, tier, benefits, and metric benchmarks, diagnose performance gaps, and drill down to the products, logistics providers, aftersales types, orders, or chats associated with specific issues. This enables ISVs to embed actionable performance insights into their solutions, helping merchants identify problem areas faster and take targeted actions to improve shop performance. Available only for US-region shops.
Use case guide: [Click here](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/ph0ccose)

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: locale
request_query_param.desc: BCP 47 locale code used to localize response text. If omitted, the default locale is resolved from the request context.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^aht_aftersales_type_items
response_param.desc: Top product items for AHT, with fields for average handle duration and the top aftersales type.

response_param.name: ^^top_aftersales_type_name
response_param.desc: Top aftersales type returned by TikTok Shop aftersales classification.

response_param.name: ^^top_type_order_count
response_param.desc: Number of orders associated with the top aftersales type.

response_param.name: ^metric_code
response_param.desc: Stable metric code selected in the request. One of: NRR, NBFR, OTDR, or AHT.

response_param.name: ^^return_order_count
response_param.desc: Number of return or refund orders.

response_param.name: ^^top_reason_order_count
response_param.desc: Number of orders associated with the top return or refund reason.

response_param.name: ^^negative_order_count
response_param.desc: Number of orders with negative reviews.

response_param.name: ^^on_time_deliver_order_count
response_param.desc: Number of orders delivered on time.

response_param.name: ^^on_time_deliver_rate
response_param.desc: On-time delivery rate as a ratio from 0 to 1.

response_param.name: ^total_count
response_param.desc: Number of items in the metric-specific list returned by this response.

scope_list.package_description: The application will be able to access TikTok shop analytics such as live and video, GMV, orders and content traffic data such as CTR, visitors for a shop and products in shop.
scope_list.auth_info: The application will be able to access your prior and go-forward TikTok Shop sales and traffic data by Shop and product, including but not limited to GMV, Number of orders, units sold, Number of buyers, product listings, product impressions and page views, Number of visitors, and click through rate (CTR), all by content type (video, live and product card).

request_path_param.name: metric_code
request_path_param.desc:
Metric code that selects the returned top-items list:
- NRR: products with negative reviews (`nrr_top_product_items`).
- NBFR: products with returns or refunds (`nbfr_top_product_items`).
- OTDR: logistics providers and their on-time delivery performance (`otdr_logistics_items`).
- AHT: products and their aftersales handling details (`aht_aftersales_type_items`).
